entry.note: Retained Q5599605 / way468118902 anchor [43.126768234,36.342740215] and heading -0.096841454998 rad remain unchanged. The six-vertex hall plan is the retained map-axis outline, not a newly extracted current building polygon. Current named mosque POI35184840207734 still says ruins; the inspected2025 pictures show rebuilt architecture. Current named Al-Hadba POI17596477684205 supplies the northwest minaret point [-36.0811989170203,-71.4911008586867]. A second Arabic minaret marker17597058803445 lies near the court center; it conflicts with the northwestern tower seen beside the hall and is retained as excluded ambiguity, not a second tall minaret. Current four-vertex garden35184869293474 constrains the east garden; courtyard arcades and narrow paths are inferred around it. Positive X east-northeast along the hall; positive Z south-southeast; the court/front faces negative Z. Site extension and lean bearing are approximations.
